title: SolidJS + TypeScript frontend foundation
objective: Strict-TS SolidJS/Vite frontend with routing, lazy routes, API client, realtime client (SSE/WebSocket), auth integration, error boundaries, telemetry hooks, accessible responsive layout, CSP-compatible build.
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck, lint, test and build pass
Routes are code-split (separate chunks in build output)
No inline scripts/styles that would violate a strict CSP
validation: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
